content_sections.heading: IIT Bhilai Consultant Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IIT Bhilai Consultant Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Social & Environmental Development Consultant: A Ph.D. in Geography, Regional Development, or a closely related discipline. Minimum 15 years of experience combining field, institutional, and corporate experience in natural resource management, watershed evaluation, and social enterprise implementation.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Social & Environmental Development Consultant: ₹ 2,00,000 consolidated monthly honorarium

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Evaluation of applications by a selection committee Interaction either physically or over VC if required

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Bhilai Social & Environmental Development Consultant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai (IIT Bhilai) for hiring skilled professionals for CSR-funded projects.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The post available for application is Social & Environmental Development Consultant under a contract employment type.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Social & Environmental Development Consultant position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Geography, Regional Development, or a closely related discipline along with relevant professional experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly honorarium of ₹ 2,00,000 for managing project responsibilities.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly through email. Candidates must send their detailed CV and necessary documents to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The final date to submit your applications via email is 07-10-2026. Make sure to apply well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the evaluation of applications by a screening selection committee followed by an interaction either physically or over video conferencing.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is required or mentioned in the official notification for applying to this consultant position.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website details?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of the institute at www.iitbhilai.ac.in to get further updates and announcements regarding this opening.
